_comment: SC-075..SC-077 — Inspector 'Clone' button: deep-clones the selected node into source store, switches view to galaxy, attaches to draggingNodeId. Implementer adds data-testid='inspector-clone' on the button + draggingNodeId field + setDraggingNode action on useGraphEditorStore.

steps.js: (() => { const set = window.__PRISM_EDITOR_SET_VIEW_MODE__; if (typeof set === 'function') set('canvas'); return 'canvas'; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const node = src.nodes[0]; ed.selectNode(node.nodeId); ed.openInspector(); ed.setEditorMode('edit'); window.__EBR2_F_03_BEFORE__ = { nodeCount: src.nodes.length, selectedId: node.nodeId }; return node.nodeId; })()

(() => { const stores = window.__PRISM_DEBUG_STORES__; const ed = stores.graphEditor.getState(); const src = stores.graphSource.getState(); const before = window.__EBR2_F_03_BEFORE__; if (!before) return false; return ed.viewMode === 'galaxy' && src.nodes.length === before.nodeCount + 1 && typeof ed.draggingNodeId === 'string' && ed.draggingNodeId.length > 0; })()
